lease: Root delegated Native supervisor budget/protocol only; PTA01 region source remains separately held.
behavior: run_legacy(...,ledger=None) retains the existing unshared implementation and its original7 contracts.
Actual shared-ledger path prepays setup JSON, reserves supervisor wire and finite child quota before dispatch, and uses the same absolute deadline.
Output is disk-spooled; each frame base and startedKiB are admitted before reads; malformed/oversized data stops without unfunded reads.
Registered cumulative child work is observed monotonically; duplicate progress is idempotent. Successful terminal+exit0+matching model settles exact known usage.
Timeout/missing/nonmonotone/overreported/error/model mismatch/after-terminal protocols retain unknown held child capacity, preserve completed validated prefix, and latch stop.
Known complete work is settled even when RSS evidence fails the request; missing RSS under a configured cap fails open with known work retained.
Bidirectional cost-model identity and outer child peak RSS do not alter semantic result records.
Cancellation/OOM/process errors return bounded typed partial/controller records without raw stderr or worker traceback text.

real_child_probe.scope: Direct actual run_legacy shared component under fresh ledger; not a complete AnalysisSession final-export measurement.

limitations: Memory enforcement is sampled combined RSS. Per-child RLIMIT_AS is distinct from aggregate OS enforcement.
Post-timeout inspection consumes only pre-reserved bounded supervisor cleanup capacity; no hard zero-overrun physical wall claim.
Output spool disk usage is not a newly introduced OS hard disk quota.
Standalone no-ledger behavior is preserved for compatibility; actual Session must pass its existing request ledger, never silently fall back.
Finite trusted process protocol validation is not a security sandbox for arbitrary hostile Python mutation of internal objects.
Root global gates, exact source binding and independent review remain required.
